description: Hot, close, smelling of yeast and burnt sugar. A counter runs the length of the room with trays racked behind it, and a hatch to the ovens. Four stools face the window onto the Green. A card on the till: WE DO NOT DO COFFEE, THERE IS A PLACE FOR THAT, TWO STREETS UP. Added in another pen: AND IT IS NOT VERY GOOD.

window.description: A wide pane onto Meltwater Row, fogged from the inside all day and wiped clear at eye height by whoever last leaned on it. Through the clear strip, the Green and the back of the statue.
window.name: the steamed front window

name: Loafing Around — Shop
